hooks.name: Confirm before git push
hooks.description: Prompts for user confirmation before any git push command is executed.

action.command: stdin=$(cat); if echo "$stdin" | grep -q '"command"' && echo "$stdin" | grep -q 'git push'; then echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"permissionDecision":"ask","permissionDecisionReason":"About to push to remote. Please confirm."}}'; fi; exit 0
